title: fix(react): useRecordSearch reads getDisplayName through a ref, not as an effect dependency
body:
Fixes #10044

## What

`useRecordSearch` (`@object-ui/react`) no longer lists the caller-supplied `getDisplayName` option in its search effect's dependency array. The resolver is read only inside a run (to label hits in the `searchAll` path and the per-object fanout path); it never decides whether a run happens. Each run now reads the resolver of the latest render through a ref (`getDisplayNameRef`, updated by a no-deps effect declared before the search effect, so it is current before any debounce timer is armed). The option's name, type and default are unchanged (Clause-② no).

## Why

AGENTS.md §5 commandment #10 bans correctness resting on a callback identity. Keyed on it, the effect's cleanup cleared the pending debounce timer on every render with a fresh resolver, so an inline arrow (the obvious spelling) gave two opposite failures. Both were reproduced on `f4f1f45` before the fix:

- renders faster than `debounceMs` never search: `expected "vi.fn()" to be called 1 times, but got 0 times`
- a sparse re-render issues a second identical request: `expected "vi.fn()" to be called 1 times, but got 2 times`

## Tests

New `describe('caller-supplied getDisplayName identity (objectui#10044)')` in `packages/react/src/hooks/__tests__/useRecordSearch.test.ts`. Every case FORCES a new resolver identity per render (inline arrow in the `renderHook` callback, fake timers); a module-level resolver would pass identically on defect and fix.

1. 10 re-renders 40 ms apart with `debounceMs: 100` ⇒ exactly one `find` call.
2. search settles, then one re-render with nothing but the identity changed ⇒ still one `find` call.
3. CONTROL: resolver swap plus a real query change ⇒ second run fires and labels hits with the new resolver (`v2:Acme Corp`). Green on defect and fix alike, so it guards against a fix that freezes the first resolver.

Reverse verification from the committed state (`8efc0b4`), script with an EXIT/INT/TERM trap: restored the `f4f1f45` hook (`getDisplayNameRef.current(` count 0, dep line count 1) ⇒ `Tests 2 failed | 21 passed (23)` (cases 1 and 2 red, control green); restored with `git checkout HEAD --` ⇒ blob `05fe6f6e` equals the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty, ref reads back to 2.

Local gates on `8efc0b4` (all exit 0):

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/react/` ⇒ `Test Files 91 passed (91)`, `Tests 1138 passed (1138)`
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/react type-check` (after building the `@object-ui/react^...` closure; `tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` includes the test file)
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/react lint` ⇒ 0 errors; the hook has 21 warnings on both `f4f1f45` and `8efc0b4`, same rules, no new ones
- `check-changeset-presence`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:test-path-roots`

Full farm is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- Behaviour change, stated in the option's JSDoc and the changeset: swapping the resolver no longer re-searches by itself. The next run uses the new resolver; results already on screen keep their labels. The three in-repo callers (`CommandPalette.tsx`, `SearchResultsPage.tsx`, `global-search-renderer.tsx`) all pass the module-level `getRecordDisplayName`, so none of them swaps resolvers. This is raised as an open question in the dev report, not decided silently.
- `dataSource` (also caller-supplied, also in the dep array) was checked and is not the same defect: it decides whether a run happens (`!dataSource`) and is the backend being queried, so a new identity is a real input change. The in-repo callers pass `useAdapter()` or a prop. Not changed here.
- Merged `origin/main` before opening: already up to date at `f4f1f45`.

## Changeset

`.changeset/10044-record-search-display-name-dep.md`, `@object-ui/react` patch.
